direct-slot.tests: the value sits in the evidence-established slot in its plainest layout

delimiter-after.tests: the byte right after the value (quote, ampersand, comma, brace, space, semicolon, CRLF, end of input) decides the span end

delimiter-before.tests: the byte right before the value (quote, equals, space, colon, tab) decides the span start

neighbouring-public-field.tests: a public lookalike (id, expiry, type, scope) next to the secret must stay outside the span

same-shape-neighbour.tests: a public value with the same alphabet and length as the secret sits next to it: shape alone must not decide

neighbouring-secret.tests: a second credential in the same document does not shift the first span

repeat-secret.tests: the same value appears twice in one document: both occurrences are the sensitive span

utf8-preceding.tests: multi-byte text (emoji, CJK, combining marks) before the slot: byte vs UTF-16 vs code point offsets

utf8-following.tests: multi-byte text right after the value or delimiter

end-of-input.tests: the value is the last bytes of the input, with no terminator (finalize path)

line-ending.tests: CRLF, tabs, indentation and trailing whitespace around the slot

nesting.tests: the slot is inside a nested JSON array/object, YAML list or URL with other parameters

big-preceding.tests: a few KB of unrelated text before the slot

glued-name.tests: a name lookalike glued to the slot name (suffix) that must stay a control, or a prefixed name observed as unsupported

near-miss-value.tests: the name is right but the value is a placeholder, reference, mask, empty, null or too short

near-miss-name.tests: the value is secret-shaped but the name or header is not the slot

alphabet.tests: Bearer values using the whole RFC 6750 b64token alphabet and padding

value-entropy.tests: a low-entropy literal in the slot: medium confidence and warn

representation.tests: a variant the handoff or the contract leaves unassertable (percent forms, quote styles, case, ambiguous layouts): observed only

stream-cut.tests: tiny chunk boundaries (7-byte and 1-byte runs): a cut inside the name, between name and value, inside the value and at the delimiter

jwt-overlap.tests: a JWT-shaped value under Bearer: one final finding, exact JWT
